description: Marble Sheen, Cup Glow & Table Limit: closes the twice-deferred sheen/anticipation-glow item and adds a calm-table rule — at most five active marbles, where each new Play press recycles the oldest with a quick silent fade (never a fail, never a count). Code-driven glass sheen, soft contact shadows, and match+approach cup glow; no new dependencies, assets, or precache entries; verified by unit tests, e2e recycling/regression runs, and the 4-viewport matrix + reliability gates.
